turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My garden gate won't latch anymore, it just swings open.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Probably the gate has sagged a little. Would you rather adjust the hinges, or move the latch to where the gate now sits?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can you hang on? I have to talk to someone here. I'll tell you when I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Are you ready for your exam tomorrow?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you hide the presents somewhere he won't look?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Top of the wardrobe, behind the winter coats.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He checks there every year, you know.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Fine. Boot of my car, then. He never goes in my car.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Perfect. And the big one, the bike?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Your neighbour said we can leave it in her shed till Sunday morning.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that took a while. I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. Your garden gate. Lifting it on the hinges, or moving the latch?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Right, fix the cause. A diagonal brace across the gate helps it stay square too.
